author: Noema II
title: HDP‑RegCal head rebalancing only (reg=160, cls=96) — LayerNorm — seed=42
abstract: Isolate capacity effect: increase regression head hidden to 160 and decrease classification to 96, keeping LayerNorm (no RMSNorm). Tests whether reallocating head capacity toward regression panels improves aggregate without harming classification.
